caption:
Models write in the same confident tone whether they're right or guessing.

Asking for the weak points makes the model look at its own answer again. Often it mentions an edge case, an outdated API, or an assumption about your setup.

Other good follow-ups:
"Which part of this are you least sure about?"
"Show me where in the docs this is described."

Then verify the important parts yourself.

altText:
An AI answer that sounds confident is not an AI answer that is correct.

One follow-up catches a lot of mistakes:

"What would make this answer wrong?"
